clue.text: Bent and mangled spider is tossed into witches' brew

indicators.note: mangled means mutilated, so the letters of spider are rearranged
into says the turned word goes inside the brew

parts.note: a witches' brew is a magic potion

indicators.note: tossed means flipped over, so the word is is turned round

explanation.surface: A gruesome recipe: a battered spider thrown into a cauldron of witches' brew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mangled' rearranges SPIDER as PREDIS; 'tossed' turns IS into SI, which goes 'into' POTION to give POSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: A bent is a natural inclination or tendency, the same idea as a leaning towards something.

clue.text: Designer of colourful flags

parts.note: flags here are flagstones, the paving slabs a street artist draws chalk pictures on

explanation.definitionFit: A street artist chalks colourful pictures on paving flagstones, so is a designer working on flags.

clue.text: Introductions? I adore somehow grabbing a kiss!

indicators.note: grabbing means seizing hold of, so the rearranged letters surround the kiss
somehow suggests the letters of I adore are arranged in some other way

parts.note: X is the usual written sign for a kiss

explanation.surface: Someone gushing about how much they love being introduced, if a kiss is involved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges I ADORE as EORDIA, which is 'grabbing' X.
explanation.definitionFit: Exordia is the plural of exordium, the formal opening or introductory part of a speech or treatise.

clue.text: I can identify vehicles from here

definitions.text: I can identify vehicles from here

parts.words: I can identify vehicles from here
parts.note: the international vehicle registration letter I marks cars from one particular country

explanation.walkthrough: International car stickers show a country code; I is the code for this country.
explanation.definitionFit: Cars registered in this country carry the international identification letter I.

clue.text: Exclamation about attire on girl's head so sanctimonious

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the exclamation goes round the other pieces

parts.note: pish is an old exclamation of contempt or impatience

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the attire comes before the next piece

parts.note: rig is clothing or outfit, as in rig-out

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone tutting at what a girl has on her head, sounding rather self-righteous.
explanation.definitionFit: Priggish people are smugly self-righteous about their own morals, as sanctimonious people are.

clue.text: As someone wise knowing about period of history

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the knowing word goes round the period

parts.note: knowing in the sense of shrewd or cunning, which is sly
an age is an era or period of history

explanation.surface: A sage being described as an expert on some era of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes acting in a wise manner, as a sage would.

clue.text: Passing rain's unfortunately penetrating marquee

indicators.note: penetrating means getting inside, so the rearranged letters go into the tent

parts.note: a marquee is a large tent

indicators.note: unfortunately signals that things go wrong with the letters, which are rearranged

parts.note: the contraction for rain is, taken as its letters

explanation.surface: A summer fete where a passing shower is soaking through the marquee.
explanation.definitionFit: Transient means fleeting or short-lived, just as something passing does not last.

clue.text: Station's letters due to be sent?

definitions.meaning: a remote military or trading station, far from the main base
read as two words, mail going out, waiting to be posted

explanation.definitionFit: An outpost is a distant station, and the word split in two describes outgoing mail.

clue.text: Trick that cornered me nastily

indicators.note: nastily suggests the letters are treated roughly and rearranged

explanation.surface: A victim complaining about a swindler who cornered them nastily.
explanation.definitionFit: Three-card monte is a street confidence trick in which the mark tries to find one card among three.

clue.text: Disregarding instrument with wrong sort of sound

parts.note: a viola is a stringed instrument
a ting is a high ringing sound, the wrong kind to come from a viola

explanation.surface: A musician ignoring the rules by making a bowed instrument give out an odd noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Violating a rule means disregarding or breaking it.

clue.text: A thing that irritates character leading heroes

parts.note: an itch is something that irritates the skin

explanation.surface: A complaint about something irritating in a story's lead hero.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter leading the word heroes is H, and this is how the letter's name is spelt out.

clue.text: Noon, and not a boy to be seen aboard

indicators.note: and not says the letter is left out

parts.note: noon is midday

explanation.surface: At twelve o'clock no lad is anywhere on the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A middy is a midshipman, a young naval trainee found aboard ship.

clue.text: It's removed in hospital — all gents operated on will receive oxygen

indicators.note: will receive means taking something in, so the oxygen goes inside
operated on suggests the letters undergo surgery and are rearranged

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A hospital ward where all the men having surgery are given oxygen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'operated on' rearranges ALL GENTS as GALLSTNE, which 'will receive' O.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallstones are hard deposits in the gall bladder, commonly removed by surgery in hospital.

clue.text: Almost a collision close to girl

parts.note: near means close by
a miss is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A driver nearly hitting a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A near miss is an incident where a collision very nearly happened.

clue.text: Evangelist in Jerusalem entertained by mean fellow

indicators.note: entertained by means received as a guest, so the city goes inside

parts.note: a miser is a stingy, mean person
Sion, a variant of Zion, is the hill in Jerusalem and a name for the city

explanation.surface: A preacher in the Holy City hosted by a stingy man.
explanation.definitionFit: A missioner is someone sent on a religious mission, a preacher spreading the gospel.

clue.text: High spirits and jerky movements may be aiding digestion

parts.note: pep is energy or high spirits
a tic is an involuntary twitching movement

explanation.surface: Lively energy and twitching after a meal said to help the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Peptic relates to digestion, especially the action of stomach juices.

clue.text: Protrude being fat in two parts!

definitions.text: Protrude being fat in two parts!

parts.words: Protrude being fat in two parts!
parts.note: a word for fat split into its two halves with a joining word between them gives a phrase for sticking out

explanation.walkthrough: Fat is STOUT; split into two parts it reads ST and OUT, and a paunch does protrude.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand out is to project or stick out from a surface, which is what protruding means.

clue.text: Attack in the morning needs something to hide in?

parts.note: AM is the abbreviation for ante meridiem, before noon
a bush is a shrub to hide in

explanation.surface: A dawn assault that needs some cover for the attackers.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambush is a surprise attack made from a hidden position.

clue.text: Clumsy but not at all like a bull

definitions.meaning: lumbering and awkward, like a large heavy animal

definitions.text: not at all like a bull
definitions.meaning: on the stock market a bull expects rises; its opposite expects falls

explanation.definitionFit: Bearish means gruff and clumsy, and in market terms pessimistic, the reverse of bullish.

clue.text: Small person in series: a nurse in Casualty, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the small person inside the series

parts.note: titch is British slang for a very small person

explanation.surface: A tiny actor appearing in a TV hospital drama as a nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: Casualty is the British name for a hospital emergency department, and also a long-running BBC drama, which feeds the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A nurse in an emergency department sews up wounds, so is an example of one who sews.

clue.text: Creatures inwardly religious may be monsters

indicators.note: inwardly says the next piece is placed inside

parts.note: hares are creatures, here standing for animals in general
pi is short for pious, meaning religious

explanation.surface: Animals that are devout at heart might nonetheless be beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Harpies are monsters of Greek myth, winged creatures with women's faces.

clue.text: Desire to have look around in the same place

indicators.note: around means the look word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
ibid, from Latin ibidem, means in the same place in a reference

explanation.surface: Wanting to glance about at a single spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Libido is sexual desire or drive.

clue.text: Not one to dash around, I was stuck in the old ways

indicators.note: was stuck in means fixed inside the turned run
around says the run of pieces is turned back to front

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
to dart is to dash

explanation.surface: Someone who never rushed about and was stuck in old-fashioned habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' turns NOT + I + DART into TRADITON, and the clue's second I 'was stuck in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradition is the customs handed down from the past, the established ways of doing things.

clue.text: Meeting supporting university needs minutes

parts.note: for means in favour of or supporting

explanation.surface: A committee backing a university wants the record of its meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a meeting or assembly for open discussion.

clue.text: Talent is modest, learner accepted

indicators.note: accepted means taken in, so the learner goes inside

parts.note: fair in the sense of moderate or middling, as in a fair amount
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Someone's gift is middling, but they were taken on as a beginner.
explanation.definitionFit: Flair is a natural aptitude or talent for something.

clue.text: Heir starts to sweat calculating inheritance — obviously nothing!

indicators.note: starts to points to the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A nervous heir works out his legacy, only to find it is nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A scion is a descendant or heir of a notable family.

clue.text: Staff in such a hospital working with detachment?

definitions.text: Staff in such a hospital working with detachment?

parts.words: Staff in such a hospital working with detachment?
parts.note: a hospital for infectious patients kept apart, where staff work at a distance from others

explanation.definitionFit: An isolation hospital kept infectious patients apart, and the word itself means detachment or separation.

clue.text: What could be the last course? That's about right (9,5) 23,027 Solution

definitions.text: What could be the last course? That's about right

indicators.note: about means going round, so the rearranged letters surround the next piece
could be suggests these letters might form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering what dessert might be, and someone confirming that is about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges THE LAST COURSE; 'about' puts that round R. The whole clue also describes the dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte russe is a cold dessert of sponge fingers around a cream filling, served as a final course.
